notes: The published title spells out a swear word ('S-H-I-T'), so this page is titled Yannick Lapointe DS; the post's title is kept only in the source citation.

Starting cards as posted under 'starting crap(8)': Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Planetary Subjugation and Prepared Defenses; all counted in the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
The 'red stuff' section is headed 23 but lists 22 cards; the deck totals 60 as published.

Posted 'insignifiant scrub' dested Insignificant Rebellion; 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order (the Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans combo was not printed until Reflections III); 'effect that make tie bomber dest +5' dested Planetary Subjugation (adds up to 5 to each TIE Bomber destiny draw).
Posted 'tie bomber squadron' dested TIE Bomber (the strategy: 'tie bomber squad have destiny 7', i.e. TIE Bomber destiny with Planetary Subjugation's +5).
Posted 'the one that make cap ship immune <4' dested We're In Attack Position Now (capital starships with a pilot aboard are immune to attrition < 4).
Posted 'the one that make WYS look stupid' (an Admiral's Order) names no card and is printed as written.
Posted 'grabbler x2' names no card and is printed as written.

Posted 'adm thran' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'papatine' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'merrelik' dested Commander Merrejk; 'masta move' dested Masterful Move; 'do or donut & empressive emforce' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement.
The post is signed 'Yannick "2001 World Champion" Lapointe' and the title says 'QC champ'; no event or finish for this list is named.
